title: 1621 Prairie climbs to its door by the drawing's side stoop
items: John H. Hamline's house at 1621 Prairie now has the stoop its 1886 drawing shows: the door opens on a stone landing along the north strip, and the steps run south along the front, past the bow, behind a low stone cheek.
The flight's run comes from the drawing's own small plan and the slope of its cheek; the number of steps, the landing's size and the stone are reconstructed, and the house card's liberties say so.
The straight stoop toward the street that stood here before is gone.
